platforms.name: Triumph (6U)
platforms.notes: Piattaforma 6U piu' volata della linea, in precedenza chiamata Trestles; array solare compatto a tre sezioni; compatibile con dispenser a rotaie (anche quelli venduti da Terran Orbital). Hardware con eredita' di volo (NASA Pathfinder Technology Demonstrator, GeoStare SV2).

platforms.name: Renegade (12U)

platforms.name: Nebula (ESPA)
platforms.power_buses: sistema a 66 V; 28 V, 12 V e 9 V disponibili per il payload
platforms.propulsion: elettrica a effetto Hall di serie (impulso specifico 2150 s), spinta 1.1 mN
platforms.dimensions: 82 x 58 x 39 cm senza pannelli solari
modules: Punti di carico 28 V alta potenza (variabili)
Punti di carico 28 V bassa potenza (variabili)
platforms.notes: Microsatellite su porta ESPA da 15 pollici o ESPA Grande da 24 pollici; crittografia Type 1 opzionale (DoD/Intel). Non e' un CubeSat. La generazione precedente (Zuma) e' servita per la Tranche 0 Transport Layer della Space Development Agency.

platforms.name: CORVUS platform family (1U-16U)
platforms.power_buses: regulated 3.3 / 5 / 12 V channels (up to 9.8 W @ 5 V, 48 W @ 12 V per channel), unregulated VBat 6.8-8.4 V (1U-3U) or 13.6-16.8 V (6U-16U)

comms.UHF: 400-402 MHz commercial or 430-440 MHz amateur, 9600/19200 bps

modules: AOCS option: magnetorquers, reaction wheels, fine sun sensors, magnetometer, gyroscopes, optional star tracker
platforms.applications: LEO, up to 5 years design lifetime
platforms.notes: One datasheet for all classes (columns 1U, 2U|3U, 6U|8U, 12U|16U). Available payload mass without AOCS: 1U up to 1 kg, 2U|3U 2.5 | 4 kg, 6U|8U 7.5 | 11.5 kg; with AOCS: 0.5 kg, 2 | 3.5 kg, 6.5 | 10.5 kg, 12U|16U 16 | 22 kg. Battery baseline 23 Wh (1U), 46 Wh, 92 Wh. Baseline 6U with star tracker: knowledge 0.5 deg, pointing 1.0 deg (1-sigma) (pointing_arcsec = [knowledge, pointing]); slew about 1.5 deg/s. GNSS 2.0 m CEP, 0.1 m/s.

source.document: Spacemanic CORVUS platform datasheet SM-COR-DS-0118 issue 3.0 (16/12/2025)

platforms.name: KRATOS 1U spacecraft bus
platforms.power_buses: 5 V @ 25 W, 3.3 V @ 10 W, 12 V @ 50 W, 1 unregulated rail

comms.SDR (70 MHz-6 GHz): full duplex, 1 transceiver and 2 receive-only ports; monopole/dipole antennas VHF to L-band

modules: ICEPS all-in-one (OBC, EPS, SDR radio, ADCS)
OBC Xilinx ARM9 dual core 733 MHz, 512 MB DDR3L, 32-512 GB SSD
EPS with 4 power rails and 4-channel UMPPT
Battery 25-100 Wh with passive heater (active optional)
platforms.notes: Payload power available 20-95 W; the summary says up to 32 W of solar power and 100 W of battery power, the EPS specification says solar array 3.75-16 W and 100 W maximum delivered power (array tables: 3-16.8 W at BOL). solar_array_power_w_max = 16 W from the EPS specification. Panel mass 460-540 g depending on 1-3 panels (platform mass not declared). Room for 6 standard payload boards and 3 cameras; operating temperature -80 to +140 C. Magnetic moment 0.14 A m2 (x4) and 0.19 A m2 (Z). Pointing accuracy not declared.

source.document: EXA KRATOS 1U spacecraft bus datasheet (newspacemarket.com copy)
